mission.name: Biblioteca di Cerea
mission.objective: Reach Biblioteca di Cerea on Viale della Vittoria and stop in Sosta Biblioteca.
mission.hint: Start beside the Municipio on Via Venticinque Aprile. Find the Biblioteca on Viale della Vittoria, north of here. Use the street signs and the atlas; stop anywhere to ask for information.

notes: Modern road geometry at local metre scale; no claim of historical reconstruction.
Designated stopping bays are gameplay placements, not verified real parking permissions.
Building footprints are sourced; heights, materials and landmark silhouettes are simplified.
One-way tags are used for directions; road-rule enforcement and traffic are not simulated.
